text.tspan: One source of truth in, several derived shapes out. Change the interface and every one of them follows.
Every field optional. The shape of a
Keep only those keys: a summary
Drop those keys: exactly what you
A lookup object: these keys, that
value type. Built from scratch, not
From functions, not interfaces: ReturnType<typeof fn> and Parameters<typeof fn>
The point is DERIVATION. Add a field to User and Partial, Pick and Omit all update themselves; hand-written copies drift.
They also compose: Partial<Omit<User, 'id'>> is the body of an update request. Note that Pick and Omit accept key names
as literal types: misspell one and Pick errors, while Omit silently ignores it.
